definitions.explanation: Showing how something works or is done by actually performing it in front of an audience, especially for products, cooking, or crafts.
Performing something live on stage or in person, as opposed to recorded or rehearsed versions.

examples.japanese: {実演|じつえん}⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: To conduct a live sales demonstration.

examples.japanese: ⟦シェフ→シェフ：05062_shefu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作|つく}り{方|かた}→作り方：27938_tsukurikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{実演|じつえん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The chef demonstrated how to make the dish.

examples.japanese: ⟦デパート→デパート：01022_depaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地下|ちか}→地下：03429_chika⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実演|じつえん}⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、つい⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧しまった。
examples.english: They were doing a live demonstration sale of Japanese sweets in the department store basement, so I ended up buying some.

examples.japanese: ⟦{伝統|でんとう}{芸能|げいのう}→伝統芸能：15098_dentougeinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実演|じつえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間近|まぢか}→間近：14527_majika⟧で⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I was able to see a traditional performing art demonstrated up close.

notes:
The compound {実演|じつえん}⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ (live demonstration sale) is extremely common in Japanese retail, especially in department stores and food halls, where vendors prepare food or demonstrate products in front of customers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実演|じつえん}⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ — live demonstration sale
- {実演|じつえん}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧ — demonstration area/booth
- {実演|じつえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ — to watch a demonstration
- {実演|じつえん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to demonstrate, to perform live

SIMILAR WORDS:
- デモンストレーション — demonstration (loanword, often shortened to ⟦デモ→デモ：19416_demo⟧)
- ⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧ — public performance (larger-scale, theatrical)
- ⟦{上演|じょうえん}→上演：11297_jouen⟧ — staging, performance (of a play or show)
